# Callouts: Recovery 1.6 - the seven probes, each checked with the beeper

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec1-6_probe-drill.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec1-6_probe-drill.jpg)

Place the seven probes P1-P7 as the boot-loader session uses them, then beep each one from its lead's end to the pad Cn on the same net. A probe that doesn't beep is re-seated.
